display_name: Mountain parapet closing end pier + stepped wall return

axes.note: Blender axes; FBX recipe maps +Y(left) -> UE -Y

lod_info: Nanite-ready opaque mesh; no manual LODs (UE auto)
usage: END of a parapet run: place with its origin on the far end of the last rs_parapet_mountain_3m (x=3.0 of that segment). Stone pier at x=0 (same as the segment pier) followed by a 1.0 m stepped wall return that dives into the hillside. Traffic face y=0.
uv: UVMap = metric box projection (1 UV unit = 1 m) for tiling materials; vertex colour Col = per-part tint (white default)
